<script setup lang="ts">
import { onMounted, ref } from 'vue'
import { useFloodStore } from '../../stores/flood'

/** 求援工单填报前选择：物业管理区域 + 预警事项（汛中阶段，交互对齐 StageFilterDialog） */
const KIND = 'mid' as const
const emit = defineEmits<{
  confirm: [payload: { complexId: string; complexName: string; eventId: string; eventName: string }]
  close: []
}>()

const store = useFloodStore()
const complexId = ref('')
const complexName = ref('')
const complexKeyword = ref('')
const complexOptions = ref<{ code: string; name: string }[]>([])
const complexSearching = ref(false)
const eventId = ref('')
const eventName = ref('')
const eventOptions = ref<{ eventId: string; eventName: string }[]>([])
const eventLoading = ref(false)
const panel = ref<'' | 'alert'>('')

onMounted(() => { void loadEvents() })

async function loadEvents() {
  eventLoading.value = true
  try { eventOptions.value = await store.fetchStageEventOptions(KIND) }
  catch { eventOptions.value = [] }
  finally { eventLoading.value = false }
}

let complexSeq = 0
async function loadComplex(keyword: string) {
  const seq = ++complexSeq
  complexSearching.value = true
  try {
    const list = (await store.searchComplex(keyword.trim(), KIND, eventId.value || undefined)).slice(0, 20)
    if (seq === complexSeq) complexOptions.value = list
  } catch {
    if (seq === complexSeq) complexOptions.value = []
  } finally {
    if (seq === complexSeq) complexSearching.value = false
  }
}

const areaOpen = ref(false)
function openAreaDropdown() {
  if (!eventId.value) return
  areaOpen.value = true
  if (!complexKeyword.value.trim() && !complexOptions.value.length) void loadComplex('')
}
function toggleAreaDropdown() {
  if (!eventId.value) return
  areaOpen.value = !areaOpen.value
  if (areaOpen.value && !complexKeyword.value.trim() && !complexOptions.value.length) void loadComplex('')
}
function onAreaInput(value: string) {
  complexKeyword.value = value
  if (!value.trim()) { complexId.value = ''; complexName.value = '' }
  window.clearTimeout(areaTimer)
  areaTimer = window.setTimeout(() => void loadComplex(value), 250)
}
let areaTimer = 0
function pickArea(option: { code: string; name: string }) {
  complexId.value = option.code
  complexName.value = option.name
  complexKeyword.value = option.name
  areaOpen.value = false
}
function openAlertPanel() { panel.value = 'alert'; areaOpen.value = false }
function pickAlert(option: { eventId: string; eventName: string }) {
  eventId.value = String(option.eventId)
  eventName.value = String(option.eventName)
  panel.value = ''
  areaOpen.value = false
  complexId.value = ''
  complexName.value = ''
  complexKeyword.value = ''
  complexOptions.value = []
  void loadComplex('')
}
function confirm() {
  areaOpen.value = false
  if (!eventId.value) { uni.showToast({ title: '请选择预警事项', icon: 'none' }); return }
  if (!complexId.value) { uni.showToast({ title: '请选择物业管理区域', icon: 'none' }); return }
  emit('confirm', { complexId: complexId.value, complexName: complexName.value, eventId: eventId.value, eventName: eventName.value })
}
</script>

<template>
  <view class="dlg-mask" @click.self="emit('close')">
    <view class="dlg-card">
      <view class="dlg-head">
        <text class="dlg-title">填报工单</text>
        <view class="dlg-close" role="button" @click="emit('close')">
          <text class="dlg-close-x">✕</text>
        </view>
      </view>
      <template v-if="panel === ''">
        <view class="dlg-field">
          <text class="dlg-label">选择预警事项</text>
          <view class="dlg-select" role="button" @click="openAlertPanel">
            <text class="dlg-select-text" :class="{ placeholder: !eventName }">{{ eventName || '请选择预警事项' }}</text>
            <text class="dlg-caret">⌄</text>
          </view>
        </view>
        <view class="dlg-field">
          <text class="dlg-label">选择物业管理区域</text>
          <view class="dlg-area-control">
            <view class="dlg-select" :class="{ disabled: !eventId }">
              <input
                class="dlg-area-input"
                :value="complexKeyword"
                :disabled="!eventId"
                :placeholder="eventId ? '请选择物业管理区域' : '请先选择预警事项'"
                placeholder-class="dlg-placeholder"
                @focus="openAreaDropdown"
                @update:model-value="onAreaInput(String($event))"
              />
              <text class="dlg-caret" role="button" @click.stop="toggleAreaDropdown">⌄</text>
            </view>
            <view v-if="areaOpen" class="dlg-area-dropdown">
              <view class="dlg-area-list">
                <view v-if="complexSearching" class="dlg-empty">搜索中…</view>
                <view v-else-if="!complexOptions.length" class="dlg-empty">暂无可选区域</view>
                <view v-for="option in complexOptions" :key="option.code" class="dlg-item" :class="{ chosen: option.code === complexId }" role="button" @click="pickArea(option)">
                  <text class="dlg-item-text">{{ option.name }}</text>
                </view>
              </view>
            </view>
          </view>
        </view>
        <view class="dlg-actions">
          <view class="dlg-btn cancel" role="button" @click="emit('close')">取 消</view>
          <view class="dlg-btn primary" role="button" @click="confirm">确 定</view>
        </view>
      </template>
      <template v-else>
        <view class="dlg-panel-head">
          <text class="dlg-panel-title">请选择预警事项</text>
          <text class="dlg-panel-back" role="button" @click="panel = ''">返回</text>
        </view>
        <view class="dlg-list">
          <view v-if="eventLoading" class="dlg-empty">加载中…</view>
          <view v-else-if="!eventOptions.length" class="dlg-empty">当前阶段暂无预警事项</view>
          <view v-for="option in eventOptions" :key="option.eventId" class="dlg-item" :class="{ chosen: String(option.eventId) === eventId }" role="button" @click="pickAlert(option)">
            <text class="dlg-item-text">{{ option.eventName }}</text>
          </view>
        </view>
      </template>
    </view>
  </view>
</template>

# agent-browser core

agent-browser drives Chrome over CDP from the command line. A snapshot returns the page's accessibility tree with a compact `@eN` ref for each element, and you act on those refs. This guide covers the loop and the common web tasks. Detailed flags, edge cases, and specialized workflows live in references and other skills; [Load more when you need it](#load-more-when-you-need-it) says which one to load for what.

## Always use your own session

Before your first command, get a session name for the task. It is stable for the worktree, so running it again prints the same name:

```bash
agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix task   # prints a name such as task-be5442ae6b6b
```

Pass that name with `--session <name>` on every command. Many agent harnesses run each command in a new shell, so an `export AGENT_BROWSER_SESSION=...` is gone by the next command, which then runs in the default session. Export the variable only when every command runs in the same shell.

The default unnamed session is one browser shared with every other agent on the machine, and it persists across conversations. Working in it can take over another agent's page or navigate away from something the human left open. Examples below omit `--session` for brevity; add it to each command.

## The core loop

```bash
agent-browser open <url>        # 1. Open a page
agent-browser snapshot -i       # 2. See what's on it (interactive elements only)
agent-browser click @e3         # 3. Act on refs from the snapshot
agent-browser snapshot -i       # 4. Re-snapshot after any page change
```

Refs stay valid for elements that survive a same-document update. Take a fresh snapshot after navigation or to observe page changes.

Prefer snapshots. Take a screenshot only when the user asks for one, or for something the DOM cannot represent, such as a canvas. Never screenshot to check whether an element exists or the page finished loading. If the snapshot is missing an element you expect, the page is usually still loading: wait for it (`wait --text "<text you expect>"` or `wait @eN`, see [Waiting]

# agent-browser core

agent-browser drives Chrome over CDP from the command line. A snapshot returns the page's accessibility tree with a compact `@eN` ref for each element, and you act on those refs. This guide covers the loop and the common web tasks. Detailed flags, edge cases, and specialized workflows live in references and other skills; [Load more when you need it](#load-more-when-you-need-it) says which one to load for what.

## Always use your own session

Before your first command, get a session name for the task. It is stable for the worktree, so running it again prints the same name:

```bash
agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix task   # prints a name such as task-be5442ae6b6b
```

Pass that name with `--session <name>` on every command. Many agent harnesses run each command in a new shell, so an `export AGENT_BROWSER_SESSION=...` is gone by the next command, which then runs in the default session. Export the variable only when every command runs in the same shell.

The default unnamed session is one browser shared with every other agent on the machine, and it persists across conversations. Working in it can take over another agent's page or navigate away from something the human left open. Examples below omit `--session` for brevity; add it to each command.
